{"name": "write_file", "arguments": {"path": "/workspace/shop/test_cart.py", "content": "import unittest
from shop.Cart import Cart, apply_discount

class TestCart(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.cart = Cart()

    def test_total_without_discount(self):
        self.cart.add_item({'price': 10, 'qty': 2})
        self.cart.add_item({'price': 5, 'qty': 3})
        self.assertEqual(self.cart.total(), 35)

    def test_total_with_discount(self):
        self.cart.add_item({'price': 10, 'qty': 2})
        self.cart.add_item({'price': 5, 'qty': 3})
        self.assertEqual(self.cart.total(10), 31.5)}"}
